plants.name: Snake Plant
plants.description: A hardy, low-maintenance plant with striking green and yellow striped leaves. Perfect for beginners and air purification.

plants.name: Monstera Deliciosa
plants.description: A trendy tropical plant with distinctive split leaves. Thrives in bright, indirect light and adds a statement to any room.

plants.name: Areca Palm
plants.description: An elegant tropical palm with feathery green fronds. Excellent for adding height and tropical vibes to your space.

plants.name: Aloe Vera
plants.description: A succulent powerhouse known for its medicinal gel. Low maintenance and drought-tolerant, perfect for sunny locations.

plants.name: Spider Plant
plants.description: A classic houseplant with arching leaves and baby plantlets. Highly adaptable and excellent for improving air quality.

plants.name: Peace Lily
plants.description: An elegant plant with dark green leaves and white spathes. Tolerates low light and indicates when it needs water.

plants.name: Jade Plant
plants.description: A succulent with thick, jade-green leaves that resemble coins. Known as the money plant, symbolizing prosperity and good fortune.

plants.name: Fiddle Leaf Fig
plants.description: A statement plant with large, violin-shaped leaves. Requires bright light and proper care but makes a stunning focal point.

plants.name: Rubber Plant
plants.description: A robust plant with glossy, deep green leaves. Excellent for air purification and adds a modern touch to any interior.

plants.name: Echeveria
plants.description: A beautiful rosette-shaped succulent with fleshy leaves. Comes in various colors and is perfect for garden arrangements.

plants.name: Pothos
plants.description: A versatile vining plant that thrives in various light conditions. Great for hanging baskets or climbing up supports.

plants.name: Zanzibar Gem
plants.description: An exotic plant with glossy, deep green leaflets arranged on stems. Extremely hardy and drought-tolerant with elegant appeal.

plants.name: Zebra Cactus
plants.description: A compact succulent with distinctive white stripes on green leaves. Ideal for small spaces and xeriscaping gardens.

plants.name: Boston Fern
plants.description: A classic fern with delicate, feathery fronds. Perfect for humid environments and adds a soft, natural aesthetic to any room.

plants.name: Bird of Paradise
plants.description: A stunning tropical plant with vibrant orange and blue flowers resembling a bird. Makes a spectacular centerpiece when blooming.

plants.name: String of Pearls
plants.description: A delicate trailing succulent with round, pearl-like leaves. Perfect for hanging planters and adds unique texture to displays.

plants.name: English Ivy
plants.description: A classic climbing vine with small, elegant leaves. Can be used as a ground cover or trained to climb walls and trellises.

plants.name: Swiss Cheese Plant
plants.description: A close cousin to Monstera with smaller split leaves resembling Swiss cheese. Compact and perfect for smaller spaces.

plants.name: Burro's Tail
plants.description: A striking trailing succulent with long tails of plump, overlapping leaves. Ideal for hanging baskets and looks stunning when trailing.

plants.name: Calathea Orbifolia
plants.description: An eye-catching plant with large, silvery-green leaves with darker markings. Requires humidity and indirect light for best results.
